snippet.title: Crisis Core –Final Fantasy VII– Reunion – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Crisis Core –Final Fantasy VII– Reunion, the HD remastered FINAL FANTASY VII prequel, is available today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/crisis-core-final-fantasy-vii-reunion-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

The story of Crisis Core –Final Fantasy VII– Reunion begins seven years before the events of FINAL FANTASY VII, following Zack Fair, a young, optimistic Shinra SOLDIER operative. As Zack and SOLDIER 1st Class Sephiroth team up to search for missing SOLDIER operative Genesis Rhapsodos, he uncovers the dark truths of Shinra’s experiments and the monsters they create. When betrayals and secrets cause him to question everything and everyone he knows, Zack must forge his own path as a hero to protect the ones he loves and defend the one thing he has left—his SOLDIER honor.

The HD remaster features:
- Complete HD graphics overhaul of the character models, UI, and background
- Newly arranged soundtrack by original composer Takeharu Ishimoto
- Fully voiced dialogue in English and Japanese, featuring key members of the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE voice acting cast
- Updated action combat system, with the option to trigger Limit Breaks and Summons and a streamlined “Digital Mind Wave” (DMW) system.

#NintendoDirect #FF7R #FinalFantasy
